segments.text: This is what a normal day looked like. I didn't know it yet.

subs.text: This is what a normal day looked like. I didn't know it yet.

segments.text: My alarm went off at seven. I hit snooze twice, like always.

subs.text: My alarm went off at seven. I hit snooze twice, like always.

segments.text: I brushed my teeth in the same mirror, with the same face.

subs.text: I brushed my teeth in the same mirror, with the same face.

segments.text: Walked to the bus stop past the same houses. The same cat sat on the same fence.

subs.text: Walked to the bus stop past the same houses. The same cat sat on the same fence.

segments.text: Afternoon cartoons. Then the news said a city name I had never heard of. I changed the channel.

subs.text: Afternoon cartoons. Then the news said a city name I had never heard of. I changed the channel.

segments.text: I sat on the porch until the streetlights came on. It was the best day I ever had.

subs.text: I sat on the porch until the streetlights came on. It was the best day I ever had.

segments.text: That night I left my window open. Someone was standing under the streetlight. I figured they were waiting for a friend.
